title:
Poké

dle

Duel
invite: {host} challenges you! The same mystery Pokémon for both of you, three rounds, the most points wins.
about: Head to head: the same mystery Pokémon for both of you, three rounds. Solve in fewer guesses, and faster, for more points.
shareText: Duel me in Pokédle! Same mystery Pokémon, fewer guesses wins.
hostPicks: The trainer who made the duel picks the format and settings; you both play by the same.
assistNote: {label}: {blurb} The trainer who made the duel picks it; you both get the same.

rules.roundsText: Three rounds, the same mystery Pokémon for both of you, with {guesses} guesses and {clues} clues ({format}), and {time} a round. You see your opponent's colours as they guess, never their Pokémon.
rules.pointsText: A solve scores {first} on the first guess down to {last} on the last, plus up to {speed} for speed. Hints cost points: category −{genus}, silhouette −{silhouette}.
rules.winningText: The most points after three rounds wins; level on points, fewer guesses, then less time. Leave, or go quiet, and you forfeit.

visitor.underWay: Under way: round {n} of {total}. {a} points to {b}.

leadIn: A new mystery Pokémon. Fewer guesses, and faster, scores more.
hintsOpen: Hints open after your first guess. They cost points if you solve.
noDex: {emoji} Pokédex assist off: no Pokédex in this duel, for either of you.

summary.draw: Level on points, guesses and time.
summary.youFewer: Level on {n} points: you needed fewer guesses.
summary.theyFewer: Level on {n} points: {them} needed fewer guesses.
summary.youQuicker: Level on {n} points and guesses: you were quicker.
summary.theyQuicker: Level on {n} points and guesses: {them} was quicker.
summary.neitherIdle: Neither of you guessed for {n} rounds.
summary.seriesNote: A rematch is game {n} of the series, with new mystery Pokémon. It starts when you both press it.
summary.rematchNote: A rematch keeps the trainers and generations, with new mystery Pokémon. It starts when you both press it.

momentumOne: {them} has it down to 1. One guess from solving!
